**Subject:**  
Single pre-adolescent female, approximately 8–12 years old. Hair styled in two high pigtails with visible braiding or twist texture; ends flared outward due to motion. Wearing a sleeveless halter-style top (pink/white patterned) and dark brown shorts. Mid-stride pose: right leg lifted, left foot contacting shallow water surface, generating splash. Arms bent at elbows, hands near hips.

**Setting:**  
Coastal marine environment. Foreground: shallow surf zone, wet sand submerged under ~5–10 cm of clear water. Background: ocean extending to horizon line. Multiple wave crests visible — one breaking mid-frame, others rolling toward shore. No structures, vegetation, or other persons present.

**Lighting:**  
Natural daylight, likely direct sun from above and slightly behind camera position. High-key illumination on subject’s front torso and face; minimal shadowing beneath arms and legs. Water surface reflects ambient light, creating bright specular highlights on splashes and ripples. Color temperature appears neutral to slightly cool.

**Composition:**  
Vertical orientation. Subject centered horizontally, occupying lower-middle third of frame. Horizon line placed near upper third, dividing sky/ocean boundary. Splash at feet anchors foreground action. Shallow depth of field — background waves softly blurred, emphasizing subject clarity. Framing excludes sky; focus remains on human-water interaction within coastal context.
